recipes.name: Korean Beef Rice Bowl
steps: Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil and pepper flakes.
Brown the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 8 minutes; drain extra fat.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 3 minutes until glazed.
Spoon over rice; top with cucumber, scallions and sesame seeds.
recipes.notes: Keeps 4 days. Reheat with a splash of water.

recipes.name: Sesame Salmon Rice Bowl
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Whisk soy sauce, honey, vinegar and sesame oil.
Place salmon on a lined pan and spoon over half the sauce.
Bake 10-12 minutes until 145F.
Serve on rice with cucumber and avocado; drizzle with the rest of the sauce and add sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Southwest Turkey Quinoa Bowl
steps: Brown the turkey in a skillet until 165F; stir in chili powder, cumin and salt.
Warm the beans and corn together.
Build bowls: quinoa, turkey, beans and corn, salsa.
Top with a spoon of yogurt and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Peanut Chicken Noodle Bowl
steps: Boil noodles per package; drain.
Sear chicken in oil 5-6 minutes until 165F.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime, honey and sriracha with 1/4 cup hot water.
Toss noodles, chicken, cabbage and carrots with the sauce.

recipes.name: Cajun Shrimp Rice Bowl
steps: Toss shrimp with Cajun seasoning.
Melt butter in a skillet; cook the pepper and corn 3 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink and curled.
Serve over rice with lemon.
recipes.notes: Shrimp overcooks fast: pull when just curled.

recipes.name: Egg and Beef Rice Bowl (Bibimbap Style)
steps: Brown the beef with 2 tbsp soy sauce; set aside.
Wilt the spinach in the pan 1 minute; season with the rest of the soy and half the sesame oil.
Fry the eggs in oil until whites are set.
Layer rice, beef, spinach and carrots; top with an egg; add gochujang and the remaining sesame oil.
recipes.notes: Cook the egg fresh. Everything else keeps 3 days.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Bowl
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Toss sweet potatoes with oil, paprika, cumin and salt; roast 25-30 minutes.
Warm the beans.
Build bowls: rice, beans, sweet potato; top with avocado, salsa and yogurt.
recipes.notes: Vegetarian. Beans and rice together give a complete protein.

recipes.name: Crispy Tofu Stir-Fry Bowl
steps: Toss tofu with cornstarch; fry in 1 tbsp oil until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli and carrots in the remaining oil 4 minutes with ginger and garlic.
Add soy sauce, honey and 2 tbsp water; return tofu; toss 1 minute.
Serve over rice.
recipes.notes: Press the tofu 20 minutes for the crispiest result.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Chicken Quinoa Bowl
steps: Mix oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic and salt; coat the chicken; marinate 30 minutes or overnight.
Roast at 425F 20-25 minutes to 175F; slice.
Serve over quinoa with cucumber, tomatoes and feta.
recipes.notes: Great cold for lunch the next day.

recipes.name: Tuna Sesame Rice Bowl
ing: cans light tuna in water, drained
steps: Mix mayonnaise and sriracha.
Toss tuna with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Serve tuna on rice with cucumber, a drizzle of the spicy mayo and sesame seeds.
recipes.notes: No cooking needed if you already have rice.

recipes.name: Sausage and Egg Breakfast Hash
steps: Fry the potatoes in oil in a large skillet, turning now and then, 12-15 minutes until golden.
Add the sausage, pepper and onion; cook 8 minutes until the sausage is cooked through (160F).
Season with salt and paprika.
Make 4 wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook 4-5 minutes until set.
recipes.notes: Hash without the eggs keeps 4 days; add fresh eggs when reheating.

recipes.name: Turkey Stuffed Peppers
steps: Heat oven to 375F. Brown the turkey until 165F; stir in rice, marinara, seasoning and salt.
Fill the pepper halves and set in a baking dish; cover with foil.
Bake 30 minutes; uncover, add cheese, bake 10 minutes more.

recipes.name: One-Pot Chili Mac
steps: Brown the beef with the onion; drain half the fat; add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes, broth and beans and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the pasta; cover and cook 12-14 minutes, stirring often, until tender.
Top with cheese.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuna Pasta (Greek yogurt)
ing: cans light tuna in water, drained
steps: Cook pasta; add the peas for the last 2 minutes; keep 1/2 cup of the water; drain.
Off the heat, stir yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, parmesan and salt with a splash of pasta water into a sauce.
Toss with the pasta, peas and tuna.
recipes.notes: Do not boil the yogurt or it splits. Eat within 2 days.

recipes.name: Beef and Potato Skillet
steps: Fry the potatoes in oil in a large skillet 12 minutes, until golden and tender.
Add beef and onion; cook until the beef is browned (160F), 8 minutes.
Add garlic, salt and paprika; top with cheese and cover 2 minutes to melt.

recipes.name: Chicken Gyro Plates
steps: Mix oil, lemon, oregano, garlic powder and salt; coat the chicken; rest 20 minutes.
Roast at 425F 20-25 minutes to 175F; slice.
Stir cucumber into the yogurt for tzatziki.
Serve chicken and tomatoes in warmed pitas with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Use bread instead of pita for a lower-effort version.
